name: Guercino

summary.text: Giovanni Francesco Barbieri, better known as (il) Guercino, was an Italian Baroque painter and draftsman from Cento in the Emilia region, who was active in Rome and Bologna. The vigorous naturalism of his early manner contrasts with the classical equilibrium of his later works.
summary.title: Guercino

259012: Et in Arcadia ego is an oil-on-canvas painting created c. 1618–1622 by the Italian Baroque artist Giovanni Francesco Barbieri (Guercino). It is now on display in the Galleria Nazionale d'Arte Antica of Rome.
4037894: Christ Crowned with Thorns or Ecce Homo is a 1647 oil on canvas painting by Guercino, depicting Jesus with a crown of thorns. It was commissioned by Marchese Tanari and for which a preparatory drawing survives in the Morgan Library.
4126304: The Raising of Lazarus is a 1619 oil-on-canvas painting by the Italian Baroque artist Guercino, now in the Louvre Museum in Paris.
4231874: Country Concert is an oil-on-canvas painting executed c. 1617 by the Italian artist Guercino. It is now in the Uffizi Gallery in Florence.
7720644: The Burial of St. Petronilla is an altarpiece painted by the Italian artist Giovanni Francesco Barbieri (Guercino) around 1623. It simultaneously depicts the burial and the welcoming to heaven of the martyred Saint Petronilla.
9138435: Abraham Casting out Hagar and Ishmael is a 1657 oil on canvas painting by Guercino, commissioned from him by the town of Cento to present to cardinal Lorenzo Imperiali, papal legate in Ferrara. It hangs now in the Pinacoteca di Brera in Milan.
Abraham Casting out Hagar and Ishmael
12077589: Allegory of Painting and Sculpture is a 1637 oil-on-canvas painting by the Italian Baroque artist Guercino, which was part of the Colonna collection until 1802 and then in 1892 formed part of the Torlonia donation to the Galleria Nazionale d'Arte Antica in Rome, where it still resides.
12139355: Moonlit Landscape is a c. 1616 oil-on-canvas landscape painting by the Italian Baroque artist Guercino, a rare instance of pure landscape in his work. It is now in the Nationalmuseum in Stockholm, to which it was donated in 1936 by court official Gösta Stenman via the Nationalmusei Vänner.
16268294: The Dying Cleopatra or The Death of Cleopatra is a c. 1648 oil painting on canvas by the Italian artist Guercino, now in the Palazzo Rosso in Genoa.
18572413: Hersilia Separating Romulus and Tatius or The Battle Between the Romans and the Sabines is a 1645 oil on canvas painting by Guercino, seized by the state during the French Revolution in 1794 and placed in the Louvre, where it still hangs.
21121975: Susannah and the Elders is a 1650 oil on canvas painting, now in the National Gallery in Parma.
21566410: Samson and Delilah is a 1654 painting by the Italian Baroque painter Giovanni Francesco Barbieri. It is on display in the Musée des Beaux-Arts of Strasbourg, France.
23021861: The Circumcision of Christ is a painting in oils on canvas executed in 1646 by the Italian artist Guercino. It depicts the Circumcision of Christ, and it was painted as the high altarpiece for a church in Bologna.
27968048: The Martyrdom of Saint Catherine is a 1653 oil on canvas painting by Guercino, commissioned by Cento to present to Cardinal Alderano Cibo, papal legate in Ferrara.
27971970: Assumption is a c. 1623 oil-on-canvas painting of the Assumption of Mary by the Italian artist Guercino, now in the Hermitage Museum in Saint Petersburg.
28035499: The Libyan Sibyl is a 1651 oil on canvas painting by Guercino. It is now in the Royal Collection, in which it was first recorded in 1790, though it had probably been purchased in Italy by Richard Dalton for George III in the early 1760s.
28796149: The Persian Sibyl is a 1647 oil on canvas painting of the Persian Sibyl by Guercino, now in the Musei Capitolini in Rome.
52830974: Jacob Blessing the Sons of Joseph is an oil-on-canvas painting created ca. 1620 by the Italian Baroque artist Guercino, now in the National Gallery of Ireland.
Jacob Blessing the Sons of Joseph (Guercino)
55831023: The Death of Dido is a 1631 oil-on-canvas painting by the Italian Baroque painter Guercino, commissioned by Cardinal Bernardino Spada for Maria de' Medici. It now hangs in the Galleria Spada in Rome.
71828584: Venus, Cupid and Mars is a 1633 oil-on-canvas painting by the Italian Baroque painter Guercino, commissioned by Francesco I d'Este for his Ducal Palace of Sassuolo around 1632–1633, when the artist was in that city to paint portraits of the d'Este family. It is now in the Galleria Estense in Modena.
75935321: Annunciation is a 1646 oil on canvas painting by Guercino, now in the collegiate church of Santa Maria Maggiore in Pieve di Cento, a few kilometres from the painter's birthplace of Cento.
106766910: Saint Jerome or Penitent Saint Jerome is an oil-on-canvas painting executed c.1640–1650 by the Italian artist Guercino, now in the Royal Palace of Naples.
106766911: Saint Joseph's Dream is an oil-on-canvas painting executed ca. 1615–1650 by the Italian Baroque artist Guercino, now in the Royal Palace of Naples.
113878786: The Suicide of Cato is a 1641 oil on canvas painting, now in the Palazzo Rosso in Genoa.
113878787: Saint Matthew and the Angel is a 1621–1622 oil-on-canvas painting, produced by the Italian Baroque artist Guercino during his early years in Rome and now in the Musei Capitolini in Rome.
119140894: Cato of Utica Bidding Farewell to his Son is an oil painting on canvas executed in 1635 by the Italian painter Guercino, now in the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Marseille since 1872.
Cato of Utica Bidding Farewell to his Son
